name: Sampler drops and risers
lesson:
## Riser four bars early, hit on the one

Sampler pad A1 holds a 4-bar riser, A2 a one-shot hit, A3 a vocal tag. Fire the riser on bar 13 so it peaks on bar 17, hit A2 on the one of 17 and again on 18, then a riser at bar 29 and the tag on bar 33.

Risers are launched a known number of bars early; one-shots land on the downbeat. Both come from the same pads and the difference is entirely in the count. Set SAMPLER VOLUME before you start so the hit sits level with the track; a sample that is louder than the mix sounds like a mistake, not an accent.

tracks.cue: Fire the sampler riser on bar 13 of the build so it peaks on the drop, hit on 17 and 18, riser at 29 and the tag on 33.
The same over the big-room build.
